assessment.rationale: Recorded because it turns one hypothesis into a family with a pre-specified order, which is exactly what the exploration budget wants before it will allow knob tuning inside a family. Directness direct; scope close. The caution is that each increment is smaller than the base effect while each adds per-step cost, and under a 300s budget the later rungs of this ladder are the most likely to be net-negative. Test the plain scale vector first and only climb if it clears.

metrics.name: terminal_loss_by_variant
metrics.result: A ladder of three composable variants, each ablated separately in Figure 5, best combination DNP+OR with IWD. Gives four follow-up candidates beyond the plain scale vector, ordered by the paper's own evidence.

locators.excerpt: Branch-Specific Heterogeneity: distinct gamma_Q, gamma_K, gamma_V instead of one shared gamma, O(d) extra parameters. Improved Placement: standard W(gamma . Norm(x)); dual-placement DP gamma^a . (W(gamma^b . Norm(x))); dual normalized-placement DNP gamma^a . Norm(W(gamma^b . Norm(x))). Magnitude-direction reparameterization OR: beta * Norm(alpha); ER: e^beta * e^(alpha - mean(alpha)). Figure 5: heterogeneity consistent gains; DP improves over standard; DNP+OR performs best; OR+IWD achieves lowest terminal loss.

statement: Replacing one shared scale vector per norm with branch-specific vectors (separate gamma for Q, K, V), improved placement around the linear map (dual placement, optionally with intermediate normalization), and magnitude-direction reparameterization each independently lower terminal loss, and combine additively.
